question: Which of the following festival is also known as 'Manipuri New Year'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cheiraoba.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Cheiraoba Festival** is also known as 'Manipuri New Year'.
 
• Sajibu Cheiraoba is the new year of the** Meiteis of Manipur.**
 
• **The Sajibu Cheiraoba** is a traditional festival celebrated on the first day of Sajibu month (the equivalent of April) every year.
 
• Other important festivals are:
 
 
• Lai Haraoba.
 
• Kang Festival.
 
• Sangai Festival.
 
• Kut Festival.
 
• Cheiraoba Festival
